key_insight: CALF-Wrapper combines a pretrained RL policy with a proven fallback controller to inherit goal-reaching and goal-maintenance guarantees under stated assumptions.
engineering_relevance: It enables deployment of performance-oriented RL controllers without requiring an additional dynamics model, online learning, or constrained optimization during execution.
method: Start with a fallback policy that provably reaches and maintains the goal set.
Use the pretrained RL policy’s critic estimate to select between the RL and fallback policies.
Establish inherited goal-reaching guarantees and probability bounds on settling time and maximum distance from the goal.
evidence_signal: Evaluation in four simulated control environments compares base, fallback, and constrained-RL policies, with sensitivity and ablation studies reporting effective performance and the maximum possible observed goal-reaching rate.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on the stated assumptions and a provably effective fallback policy; simulation success alone does not establish real-world reliability.
paper_title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
